pricing/index.html.body: Compare the written scope with the acquisition process and BNB Accelerator reviews. Confirm the work included, independent-provider costs, your responsibilities and cancellation terms before engaging the team.

how-it-works/index.html.heading: Make an informed decision about acquisition support
how-it-works/index.html.body: Review pricing and service scope, read BNB Accelerator reviews and client stories, and bring your purchase budget and open questions to the application discussion. A company-reported case study is not a forecast for your property.

blog/airbnb-revenue-projections/index.ht.description: Compare seller history, comparable rentals and monthly assumptions. Stress-test Airbnb revenue projections against operating costs and debt before buying.
blog/airbnb-revenue-projections/index.ht.heading: Use your projections to prepare an acquisition discussion
blog/airbnb-revenue-projections/index.ht.body:
Bring the listing, seller revenue records, comparable-property sources, monthly assumptions and expense quotes. Keep the downside case visible when discussing the purchase price. Review the revenue evidence checklist and BNB Accelerator’s acquisition scope and fees.

blog/switching-property-managers/index.h.title: Switch Airbnb Property Managers: Bookings & Handoff
blog/switching-property-managers/index.h.description: Plan an Airbnb property-manager change around the contract, future reservations, listing control, guest communication and operating handoff.
blog/switching-property-managers/index.h.heading: Changing managers or buying a property with bookings?
blog/switching-property-managers/index.h.body: Replacing a manager for a property you already own is a different decision from taking ownership of a seller’s rental. If you are buying, review future reservations at closing and document the responsibilities of the seller, manager and buyer. BNB Accelerator’s service is acquisition support; confirm any post-closing coordination in writing rather than assuming ongoing property management is included.

blog/future-reservations-at-closing/inde.heading: Already own the property and changing managers?
blog/future-reservations-at-closing/inde.body: Use the property-manager transition guide for contract notice, listing control and operating handoff. A manager change and a property purchase have different parties and responsibilities; confirm what happens to existing reservations with the professionals and platform involved.
